title: The Queen Behind
setup: Black's king on e6 and its queen on f6 are standing side by side on the sixth rank.
hint: Check along the rank those two share, entering from the side where the queen is the one standing behind.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qd6+}} is a skewer: the check arrives on the sixth rank with the black queen stranded behind its own king. Your pawn on **e5** covers d6 and f6, so the king cannot capture. {{Kf5}} is forced and {{Qxf6+}} takes the queen for nothing.
